post.description: Creates a new gallery in VSCO Workspace.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

jobId.description: A ULID entity identifier that is nullable.

eventId.description: A ULID entity identifier that is nullable.

remoteId.description: The remote ID of this gallery. This value must be unique for the studio.

coverPhoto.description: When creating or updating a gallery, this object may be used to import a cover photo. If the gallery does not yet have a covor photo, VSCO Workspace will use a placeholder graphic.

public.description: Whether this gallery is publicly accessible.

password.description: A reusable plain-text passcode for unlocking the gallery. This pass code may be given to invited users.

category.description: The category of this gallery. Galleries may be grouped by this category text in future client portal designs.

releaseDate.description: The date this gallery will be released to the public. Useful in automations or email tokens.

eventDate.description: The date of the event this gallery is for. Useful in automations or email tokens.

expirationDate.description: The date this gallery will expire and no longer be accessible. Useful in automations or email tokens.

orderDueDate.description: The date that orders for this gallery are due by. Useful in automations or email tokens.

orderCount.description: The number of orders placed for this gallery.

photoCount.description: The number of photos in this gallery.

visitorCount.description: The number of visitors to this gallery.

headline.description: The headline of this gallery. Prioritized over name when displayed to the user.

slug.description: The URL path slug for this gallery. This is the URL-friendly version of the name and must contain only letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores. When setting this value, it will be converted to lowercase and any illegal characters stripped.

clientUrl.description: The URL of this gallery. Will be used for links in emails and the client portal.
